variants.label: staircase fold of the three tall rooms + row squeeze
variants.architecture: The three tall rooms spent TWO rows per instruction: a west leg carrying nothing but a carriage return, then an east leg carrying one instruction. src/littleman/alexey_stairfold.py merges consecutive east legs whenever their instruction columns increase across the join, deleting the west leg between them. Legal because every inbound pipe of these rooms lands on the top wall and every outbound one leaves through the bottom, so the row term of the Manhattan distance cancels and the zone is column-only -- rows are free, columns frozen. 82 rows freed; a rows-only squeeze then removed 40 of them globally. The column pass must NOT be run: columns are what decide the zones, and it drops to 1/6.

localValidation.note: ticks fell 21% as well -- the man walks the carriage returns no more

variants.verdict: BEST. 5.6x from the 9.37B baseline. Three pipes shortened (94->78, 335->295, 233->193) and the buffers held on all 20 server cases.
